items.text: Entered the Kyoto Municipal General Advanced Technical Ceramic School (graduated 1917)
Course in the pottery wheel at the training facility of the Kyoto Ceramics Laboratory; hired as an assistant at the station
Assistant to Tomimoto Kenkichi (for about three years)
Studied sketching and Western-style painting at Kansai Art Academy and Western Art Research Institute; established his studio and kiln at Kiyomizu, Kyoto
Prize at the 9th Teiten (Imperial Art Academy) Exhibition for the first time, going on to win it 13 times in a row
Highest honours at the 3rd Bunten Exhibition
Gold award for Japanese Traditional Crafts at the 3rd Japan Traditional Art Crafts Exhibition (Sansui Dyed Pot)
Medal of Honor with Purple Ribbon (Shiju Hosho)
Order of the Sacred Treasure (Zuihosho); Kyoto City Cultural Order Award / Person of Cultural Merit of Kyoto
Designated Living National Treasure (Important Intangible Cultural Property holder) for sometsuke (blue-and-white) ceramics
Assistant professor, Kyoto City University of Fine Arts
Rejoined Nihon Kogeikai (Japan Art Crafts Association); later executive director and chairman of its Ceramics Division
Professor, Kyoto City University of Fine Arts
Chancellor (president), Kyoto City University of Fine Arts
Stayed in the village of Laresin, Iran, making ceramics with the local kiln and materials
